'Allah and His Angels exalt the Prophet. O you who believe, invoke abundant blessings and salutations upon him.'</span
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مَنْ أَشْرَفُ الأَسْمَاءِ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمْ
Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalā man ashraful asmāʾi sayyidunā Muḥammadun ṣallAllāhu ʿalayhi wasallam.

Sayyidunā Khaṭībul Umam ṣallAllāhu ʿalayhi wasallam.
Our Master, Addresser of All Nations (Khaṭīb al-Umam) , may Allah exalt and preserve him.
سَيِّدُنَا عَلَمُ الهُدَى صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمْ
Sayyidunā ʿAlamul Hudā ṣallAllāhu ʿalayhi wasallam.
Our Master, Banner of Guidance ('Alam al-Hudā) , may Allah exalt and preserve him.
سَيِّدُنَا كَاشِفُ الكُرَبِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمْ
Sayyidunā Kāshiful Kurab ṣallAllāhu ʿalayhi wasallam.
Our Master, Remover of Fears (Kāshif al-Kurab) , may Allah exalt and preserve him.
سَيِّدُنَا رَافِعُ الرُّتَبِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمْ
Sayyidunā Rāfīʿur Rutab ṣallAllāhu ʿalayhi wasallam.
Our Master, Raiser of Ranks (Rāfi' al-Rutab) , may Allah exalt and preserve him.
سَيِّدُنَا عِزُّ العَرَبِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمْ
Sayyidunā ʿIzul ʿArab ṣallAllāhu ʿalayhi wasallam.
Our Master, Glory of the Arabs ('Izz al-'Arab) , may Allah exalt and preserve him.
سَيِّدُنَا صَاحِبُ الفَرَجِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمْ
Sayyidunā Ṣāhibul Faraj ṣallAllāhu ʿalayhi wasallam.
Our Master, Bringer of Relief (Ṣāḥib al-Faraj) , may Allah exalt and preserve him.

اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ بِجَاهِ نَبِيِّكَ المُصْطَفَى وَرَسُولِكَ المُرْتَضَى طَهِّرْ قُلُوبَنَا مِنْ كُلِّ وَصْفٍ يُبَاعِدُنَا عَنْ مُشَاهَدَتِكَ وَمَحَبَّتِكَ، وَأَمِتْنَا عَلَى السُّنَّةِ وَالجَمَاعَةِ وَالشَّوْقِ إِلَى لِقَائِكَ، يَا ذَا الجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ. وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا. والحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ.

Allāhumma yā rabbi bijāhi nabiyyikal muṣṭafā wa rasulikal murtaḍā ṭahhir qulūbanā min kulli waṣfin yubāʿidunā ʿan mushāhadatika wa maḥabbatika wa amitnā ʿalās sunnati wal jamāʿati wash shawqi ʾilā liqāʾika yā dhāl jalāli walʾikrāmi wa ṣallAllāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muhammadin wa ʿalā ʾālihi wa ṣaḥbihi wa sallama taslīman wal ḥamdu liLlāhi rabbil ʿālamīna.

O Allah , by the honour of Your Chosen Prophet and Your Approved Emissary, purify our hearts of any trait that would distance us from beholding You and being loved by You. Grant that we die adhering to the Sunna and the [Muslim] Community, longing to meet You, O Lord of Majesty and Magnanimity. May Allah's exaltation and abundant salutations be upon our Master Muḥammad and his Family and Companions. And all praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
Asmāʾ al-Nabī ﷺ — 203.
